items.title: Frank Murray Interview, 1960-05-12
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...And my name is Dick Allen. What's yours name? Frank Murray.

ctx.x: Let's see, this is an interview, a recording of music. We're making it today up at 1323 South Rampart Street. What's today's date? May the 12th. May the 12th, 1960. And my name is Dick Allen. What's yours name? Frank Murray. Frank Murray. M-U-R-R-A-Y. Murray, or Murray sometimes. Murray, yeah. And your name? Paul Crawford. Okay. You want to give us a little sample of the blues or something?

Well, a very old popular jazz song is Who's Sorry Now? Who's sorry now? Who's sorry now? Whose heart is breaking for a break in each bar? Who's sad and blue? Who's car in two? Just as I cried over you. Right from the start Just like a friend I tried to warn you somehow You had your way Now you must pray I'm glad that you'm sorry now Who's sorry now? Who's sorry now?
